in_sanskrit.name: Ayanuth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born from the Vedas
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayanuth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayanuth is a name derived from the ancient Vedic texts. It is believed to mean 'Born from the Vedas'. In Hindu mythology, the Vedas are considered the primary source of knowledge and wisdom. Thus, the name Ayanuth signifies a deep connection to spiritual knowledge and tradition.
